description: This is a code-behind ASP.NET webform written in C# for the 'EditTheory' page within an Online Examination System. It handles page load, navigation button clicks, course selection logic based on semester/year, and session management.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page managing course editing and navigation in the Online Exam System.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event of the page. Currently performs no specific actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transitions to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transitions to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transitions to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets a session variable '_CRS' with the selected course from the dropdown.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transitions to the Login page, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester or year via predefined course lists.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown when the semester selection changes, regenerating course options.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Currently empty; placeholder for handling course selection changes.
